scope: Bounded greedy acceptance of a signed-INT8/FP8 TP-2 target with a released BF16 drafter. Not a routed RTL throughput or nine-workload production tau.
limitations: The paired BF16 reference is the prefix of a 2048-token BF16 run on the same prompts; target arithmetic can change the later greedy trajectory.
DFlash's released block-16 drafter runs at block 5 outside its training distribution.
The released BF16 drafter is not the O4 INT8 drafter; this run isolates target arithmetic only.
The prompt subset excludes the longest agentic contexts and does not support replacing the nine-workload production tau.
